mutations.name: work.loop-tier is registered as a read
kills: work.loop-tier refuses on loopback because it is an owner write

mutations.name: an old daemon reads as an empty board
mutations.find: if (isUnknownCommand(error)) return { fetchedAt, board: null, unavailable: OLD_DAEMON };
mutations.replace: if (isUnknownCommand(error)) return { fetchedAt, board: { ledger: null, loops: [], tree: null, warnings: [] }, unavailable: null };
kills: work.loops reports an old active-work daemon as unavailable, not as an empty board

mutations.name: the tier answer drops the ledger's rank
kills: work.loop-tier passes the owner's move to active-work's loop.tier and answers the new tier and rank, read from the ledger's tier_rank
